name: Unwip 0.43.19
body: Fixes: - Importing Markdown (Obsidian and others): formatting written as HTML tags inside the Markdown now comes across as formatting, so underline, bold, italic, strikethrough, superscript, subscript and line breaks work alongside the usual *italics* and **bold**. Other tags, like coloured s, are dropped but their words kept. sha256: abf33c19c8c27494386e55f283ebbbad1c0a47fdab5643e042d7cbd086c70857
